class: A dated reference list loaded once (the NSE F&O holiday calendar) with no check on how far it reaches makes every behaviour that depends on it fail closed on the first day past its end: from that day the app reads every session as closed - no rule checks, no paper fills, no warnings - and nothing warns before it happens.
mechanism: backend/ofo/market_calendar.json holds the 2026 NSE F&O trading holidays (fetched 2026-10-19); a date outside the listed year cannot be placed and the market state fails closed (NOT_CONNECTED, market_closed true).

first_seen.where: GC-ICGUIDE task 30, test data PATH-64 (NIFTY monthly 25 Jan 2027), strategy 126
first_seen.evidence: GET /api/market/indices at scenario clock 2027-01-04T11:30+05:30 -> {"state":"NOT_CONNECTED",...,"market_closed":true}; adjustment check withheld 'prices stale or missing' at 2027-01-04 11:00 and 11:30; 2026-12-16 11:00 on the same path checked normally (T-01 1.4015%).

fix: Not fixed in GC-ICGUIDE (deferred issue). Proposed: load the next year's NSE list when published (December); a daily check warns 30 days before the last listed date and the app refuses to start in live mode on or after 1 Dec without the next year's list.

detection.note: No check reads how far the calendar reaches. Unguarded until the 30-day warning and the start-up refusal exist with tests.
